protocol.name: cupertino_layers_v1

description.summary: layers the server places, blends and animates for a client's own surfaces

protocol.description:
Public protocol: a client hands the server parts of a window as layers, each a surface of its own placed in fractional points over a parent surface, and lets the server move, fade, scale and reveal them along timed curves and springs on the server's clock, so a transition runs at the display's rate while the client is busy and costs it no repaint per frame. A layer may carry glass that moves with it, a blend role that mixes its pixels with the glass behind it, a raised elevation that lifts it above its siblings, a pointer-lit rim and a blur that varies across it. Scrolling and other motion that follows the pointer stay with the client: it moves layers with a cheap commit per frame and no repaint.
A request names surfaces of the client that sends it; the server never lets a client place or animate another client's surface.

interface.name: cupertino_layers_v1

description.summary: makes surfaces layers of a parent surface

interface.description: Global singleton, offered to every client.

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: a surface belongs to another client or is gone

entry.name: role
entry.summary: the surface already has a role or is the parent, or the parent is a layer

entry.name: too_many_layers
entry.summary: the parent or the client holds as many layers as the server allows

request.name: destroy

description.summary: unbind the global

request.description: Layers created through this global stay valid.

request.name: get_layer

description.summary: make a surface a layer of a parent surface

request.description:
Gives the surface the layer role and makes it a layer of the parent, drawn above the parent's own surface tree. The layer appears with the parent's next commit, at its initial state: at the parent's origin, its bounds the size of its content, opacity 1, scale 1, no corner radius, no glass, the normal blend role and the flat elevation. Layers of a parent are drawn in creation order, later ones above, and raised layers above all flat ones. The parent is a window's or a layer shell surface's main surface, and is not a layer itself. A surface that is a layer of the parent may become one again after its layer object was destroyed.
The layer's content is the surface's own buffer and applies on the surface's own commit, never waiting for the parent: see the late-content rule of cupertino_layer_v1. Its geometry and look apply with the parent's commit.
Posts invalid_surface when either surface belongs to another client, role when the surface already has a role or is the parent or the parent is a layer, and too_many_layers when the parent already holds 64 layers or the client 256 (layers that are not destroyed count).

interface.name: cupertino_layer_v1

description.summary: a surface placed, blended and animated by the server over its parent

interface.description:
All state is double-buffered on the parent surface: it applies on the parent's next wl_surface.commit, together with that commit's buffer, and a synchronized parent caches it with its own state. So the parent's content, its layers' places and the animations it starts always change in the same frame.
Geometry is in fixed point, in the parent's logical points, so a layer lands on the device pixels of a scaled output: its origin is rounded to the output's device pixels when drawn and never to whole logical points.
Animations run on the server's clock: an animation starts when the frame showing the commit that started it is drawn (and at the latest 100 milliseconds after that commit when no output shows the parent), and follows the session's time scale and the fixed time tests set. A new value or animation of a property retargets it from the value and velocity shown at its start: the motion stays continuous in both. While reduce_motion is on (cupertino_appearance_v1), animations of the spatial properties (x, y, width, height, scale, corner_radius) end at their target in their first frame; opacity animates as asked, so a transition becomes a fade.
Input: a layer takes no input. Pointer and touch go to the surfaces below, the parent's, in the parent's coordinates, and the client hit-tests against the layers' target values, not the values shown during an animation. Semantics: the accessible bounds a client publishes for a layer's content are its target values; settled tells desktop control when they are what is shown.
Clipping: a layer is drawn only inside its parent's window, its rounded corners included, and with masks_to_bounds inside its own rounded bounds.
Late content: the parent's commit never waits for a layer's content. When a commit shows a part of the layer's bounds its content does not cover (a scroll that outruns the drawing), that part shows the layer's placeholder colour until the content arrives; content that arrives later shows from the layer surface's own commit, at the geometry the server shows then.
When the parent is destroyed the layer becomes inert and draws nothing. Destroying the layer surface removes the layer at once.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: opacity outside 0 to 1, a negative size, scale, radius or blur, or a lens below 1

entry.name: invalid_property
entry.summary: a property, glass style, blend role, elevation or highlight not defined at the object's version

entry.name: invalid_curve
entry.summary: a duration over 10 seconds, Bézier x control points outside 0 to 1, or a spring response outside 0.01 to 10 seconds or damping ratio outside 0.05 to 4

entry.name: too_many_animations
entry.summary: the client has as many animations running or waiting as the server allows

entry.name: x
entry.summary: the origin's x, in the parent's logical points

entry.name: y
entry.summary: the origin's y, in the parent's logical points

entry.name: width
entry.summary: the bounds' width, in logical points

entry.name: height
entry.summary: the bounds' height, in logical points

entry.name: opacity
entry.summary: opacity of the layer, its glass included, from 0 to 1

entry.name: scale
entry.summary: scale of the layer, its glass included, about the bounds' centre

entry.name: corner_radius
entry.summary: the radius of the bounds' continuous corners, in logical points

entry.name: normal
entry.summary: the content is drawn over what lies behind it

entry.name: vibrant
entry.summary: the content's coverage is drawn as a colour taken from the glass behind it: brightened and saturated over a dark face, darkened over a light one, for text and symbols

entry.name: vibrant_secondary
entry.summary: vibrant, at the weight of secondary text and symbols

entry.name: vibrant_fill
entry.summary: vibrant, at the weight of a fill behind controls

entry.name: flat
entry.summary: in the parent's plane

entry.name: raised
entry.summary: lifted above every flat layer of the parent, its glass casting a soft shadow; its glass reads the flat layers and the parent beneath it, so a lifted thumb or a lens shows what it lies over

entry.name: fixed
entry.summary: the glass rim is lit from above

entry.name: pointer
entry.summary: the glass rim is lit from the pointer while it is over the parent's output, from above otherwise

request.name: destroy

description.summary: remove the layer

request.description: The layer disappears with the parent's next commit; its running animations end without events. The surface keeps the layer role and may become a layer of the same parent again.

request.name: set_value

description.summary: set a property at once

request.description: The property jumps to value with the parent's commit. A running animation of the property is replaced (see replaced). Posts invalid_property for an unknown property and invalid_value for a value outside the property's range.

request.name: animate_timed

description.summary: animate a property along a timed curve

request.description: Moves the property to value over duration milliseconds along the cubic Bézier through (0, 0), (x1, y1), (x2, y2) and (1, 1), from the value and velocity shown when it starts. serial names the animation in finished and replaced. Within one commit, set_value requests apply before animations, so a set_value and an animation of the same property in one commit animate from the set value. Posts invalid_property, invalid_value, invalid_curve or too_many_animations; the client may have 512 animations running or waiting.

request.name: animate_spring

description.summary: animate a property along a spring

request.description: Moves the property to value along a damped spring: response is the period of the undamped spring in seconds and damping its damping ratio (1 settles without overshoot, below 1 bounces). The spring starts from the value and velocity shown when it starts; velocity (units per second) is its initial velocity when the property is at rest, as after a gesture's release. The animation finishes once the property stays within a thousandth of a unit of its target. Posts invalid_property, invalid_value, invalid_curve or too_many_animations.

request.name: cancel

description.summary: stop a property where it is shown

request.description: Stops the property's animation at the value shown when the parent's commit applies; the animation is replaced (see replaced). Posts invalid_property for an unknown property.

request.name: set_glass

description.summary: draw glass below the layer's content

request.description: Glass of style drawn in the layer's rounded bounds, below its content, moving, scaling and fading with it. The styles are the values of cupertino_backdrop_v1.glass_style (cupertino_app_effects_v1); 4294967295 removes the glass. lens magnifies what the glass shows about the bounds' centre (1 shows it at its size). Posts invalid_property for an unknown style and invalid_value for a lens below 1 or above 4.

arg.name: style
arg.summary: a cupertino_backdrop_v1.glass_style value, or 4294967295 for none

request.name: set_blend

description.summary: choose how the content mixes with the glass behind it

request.description: A vibrant role takes the content's alpha as coverage and draws it in a colour derived from what lies behind it, following the appearance and the display options: with reduce_transparency or increase_contrast it draws the plain label colour of the appearance at the role's weight. Posts invalid_property for an unknown role.

request.name: set_elevation

description.summary: lift the layer above its siblings

request.description: Posts invalid_property for an unknown elevation.

request.name: set_highlight

description.summary: choose where the glass rim is lit from

request.description: Posts invalid_property for an unknown highlight.

request.name: set_blur_ramp

description.summary: vary the blur of the layer's glass from its top to its bottom

request.description: The glass blurs at top times its style's blur along its top edge and at bottom times it along its bottom edge, smoothly in between, as the soft edge of a bar over scrolled content. 1 and 1 (the initial state) blur evenly. Posts invalid_value for a negative weight or one above 1.

request.name: set_masks_to_bounds

description.summary: clip the content to the rounded bounds

request.description: 1 clips the layer's content to its rounded bounds, 0 (the initial state) only to the parent's window.

request.name: set_placeholder

description.summary: the colour shown where content has not arrived

request.description: Straight red, green, blue and alpha from 0 to 1 shown in the part of the bounds the content does not cover; the initial colour is transparent. Posts invalid_value for a channel outside 0 to 1.

event.name: finished

description.summary: an animation reached its target

event.description: Sent once, in the frame the property reached the target of the animation named serial.

event.name: replaced

description.summary: an animation was replaced before it finished

event.description: A later set_value, animation or cancel of the same property replaced the animation named serial; value and velocity (units per second) are what was shown when it was replaced, the start of the motion that follows.

event.name: settled

description.summary: every property of the layer shows its target

event.description: Sent when the last running or waiting animation of the layer finished or was replaced by a set value: what is shown is again what the client hit-tests and publishes.
